name: Sausage and Spinach Crustless Quiche
why: Genuine egg/cheese-bound crustless quiche; all ingredients map to the board (eggs, cream-cheese, heavy-cream, cheddar-cheese-shredded, breakfast-sausage, spinach). Published 429 cal / 2g carbs sits mid-band on calories and near-zero carbs. LOWER CONFIDENCE / weaker fit: published protein is only 18g at 10 servings (fat 38g), below the catalog's 25g+ high-protein identity - it clears THIS run's cal/carb band but is a fat-forward quiche, not protein-forward. Include only if the selector wants a low-carb egg-cheese filler; the cottage-cheese bake above is the stronger pick.
